# Apex Vitality

> Apex Vitality offers two distinct service routes: educational gut-health and metabolic-balance wellness coaching, and licensed men's medical care for eligible adults physically located in California. Apex Vitality is operated by Elite Functional Health, a Professional Nursing Corporation.

## Public service routes

- [Gut Health & Metabolic Balance](https://goapexvitality.com/gut-health): Educational nutrition, digestive-wellness, lifestyle, habit, tracking, and accountability coaching. It may include personalized educational review of wellness-related laboratory patterns and functional ranges. It does not diagnose, treat, prescribe, direct medication changes, order diagnostic testing as medical care, or provide clinical interpretation of laboratory results.
- [Men's Hormone Health](https://goapexvitality.com/mens-health): California medical evaluation for men concerned about symptoms or laboratory findings that could reflect a hormone deficiency. Testing, treatment, prescriptions, and monitoring are provided only when legally permitted and clinically appropriate.

## Practice information

- [Frequently asked questions](https://goapexvitality.com/faq)
- [Contact](https://goapexvitality.com/contact)

## Important boundaries

Wellness coaching is educational and is not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Medical treatment and prescriptions require an appropriate evaluation by a licensed clinician and are offered only where legally permitted and clinically appropriate. Urgent or concerning symptoms should be evaluated by an appropriate medical professional or emergency service.
